THE PRACTICAL PART

Refill. Clean. Repeat.

Pour seed through an open lancet portal into the shallow well; crown releases for full cleanout.

This is a shallow seed well, not a sealed storage hopper. Remove the feeder from its hanger before releasing the roof or tower.

What you need

A suitable printer, compatible filament, and appropriate outdoor suspension hardware. The integral eye suspends the assembled feeder; the cord or support is not a printed part. No camera, batteries, app or subscription are needed.

Supplied 3MF filament type: PETG. ASA is an outdoor alternative, not a drop-in profile substitution: change the profile, re-slice and test the fit. Use manufacturer ventilation guidance.

Download editable source ZIP

Assembly sequence

  1. Snap the tower onto the balcony tray; check every external hook engages its receiver window.
  2. Press the seed well into its two tray latches.
  3. Press the crown onto the tower until every downward roof hook engages.
  4. Hang the complete rigid assembly from the one integral top eye. To clean, remove from hanger, pull exposed tabs outward and lift components apart.

Part-specific support notes

  • Drained balcony tray
    None; tray flat on bed.
  • Masonry tower shell
    None; upright
  • Snap weather crown
    Organic support beneath external snap hooks; roof upright
  • Removable seed well
    None; upright

Before hanging it outdoors

  • Digital prototype: print fit coupons, verify snap retention and weather resistance before outdoor use.
  • Outdoor ASA recommended; preserve 0.4 mm wall-to-flexure clearance.
  • Drain holes are 2.8 mm diameter. Remove roof and shell for brush cleaning.
  • No clear sheet, loose glazing, cords through parts or bought-in retainers.

Use shallow daily portions, remove wet seed, keep drains open, and inspect joints and suspension points. Test near the ground before installing over people, pets or property.
